fields.title: Dusklight: Twilight Princess Native Mobile Port
fields.platform: GameCube/Wii → Android ARM64 and iOS ARM64; also Windows, Linux, and macOS
fields.status: The official Dusklight v2.0.3 release (2026-09-30) includes an Android ARM64 APK and iOS ARM64 IPA. The README says all commercial discs are supported except the Korean Wii release and describes OpenGL ES on older Android devices as best-effort; users must dump their own game copy.
fields.summary: Official mobile builds of Dusklight, a reverse-engineered native reimplementation of Twilight Princess based on the GameCube decompilation. The v2.0.3 release ships Android ARM64 and iOS ARM64 packages alongside desktop builds. The app contains no copyrighted game data; the player supplies a supported disc dump. Android OpenGL ES support on older devices is best-effort.
fields.strategy: Reverse-engineered native reimplementation packaged for Android/iOS and desktop; requires user-supplied disc data.
fields.source_available: Public CC0-1.0 source repository and Android APK/iOS IPA releases. The player must provide a supported, legally dumped game disc; no game data is distributed.
fields.subtype: Official Android ARM64 and iOS ARM64 builds; Android OpenGL ES fallback is best-effort

fields.title: Silent Hill Native PC and Mobile Port (PS3 in Development)
fields.platform: Original PlayStation → Windows PC, Android, and iOS; OG Xbox beta; PS3/PSP listed as in development
fields.status: The current crossplatform-beta release contains Android APK and iOS IPA assets, with APK/IPA files updated through 2026-10-12. In its 2026-09-04 announcement, the maintainer says Android/iOS builds are playable and support touch controls; Android Arcade1Up support still needs work. The PS3 target tracked by this row remains in development, with no PS3-specific playable milestone documented.
fields.summary: A native source port based on the PlayStation decompilation, using PsyCross rather than emulation or static recompilation. The project now ships PC, Android, and iOS builds; its maintainer reports playable mobile builds with touch controls. The cross-platform beta also includes an OG Xbox build, while PS3/PSP remain listed as in-development targets. Game data is not included and must come from the user’s own PlayStation disc.
fields.strategy: Decompilation-based native source port using PsyCross, with PC, Android, and iOS builds; console targets have separate maturity levels.
fields.source_available: Public GPL-3.0 source for the PC port and its additions, plus Android APK/iOS IPA beta builds. The project does not license or distribute the underlying PlayStation decompilation or game data; a user-supplied disc is required.
fields.subtype: Native Android/iOS beta and PC port; OG Xbox beta; PS3/PSP in development

fields.status: Release v0.1.2 was published 2026-10-16 UTC. The README reports the Eevee v1.0.0 base game playable on Windows at a stable 30 fps from the opening movie and introduction through exploration, wild captures, trainer battles, menus, Pokédex, Play with Eevee, and save/load. The game has not been played from start to finish; only the specified Eevee base-game version is supported, and Pikachu/update versions are not.

fields.status: The maintainer README describes a native Horizon port paced at locked 60 FPS with direct console audio output and remappable Switch controls. Release v1.00b-r5 (2026-09-30) adds Key Config support, maps ZL/ZR to L/R, standardizes the NRO name to touhou7.nro, and recommends sd:/switch/touhou/touhou7/; the release says gameplay is unchanged.
